children: The price fetched by Amplitude Energy for its natural gas in 1Q should improve on the prior three months, supporting growth in revenue. That's the view of Bell Potter analyst Stuart Howe, who points to higher gas volumes in the quarter. Also, spot natural gas prices recovered to a quarterly average of A$9.77 per gigajoule, from A$8.42 per gigajoule in 4Q of FY26. Amplitude is due to report its 1Q performance on Oct. 19. Bell Potter retains a buy call and A$2.45/share price target on Amplitude, which ended Monday at A$1.74. (david.winning@wsj.com; @dwinningWSJ)
